paper_title: First Axion-Like Particle Results from a Broadband Search for Wave-Like Dark Matter in the 44 to 52 $μ$eV Range with a Coaxial Dish Antenna
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, plotted directly on linear y-axis (x10^-11)
notes: GigaBREAD dish-antenna ALP search, 44-52 ueV (10.7-12.5 GHz), 3.9 T, room temperature, 90% CL exclusion on g_agamma. Coupling type unambiguous (axion-photon, Eq.1 with F~F). Numerical limit values not tabulated in the text; the exclusion curve is only shown in Fig.3.
